001package dayplanner;
002
003
004/**
005 * <p>
006 * Represents an instant in time with minute-level precision. This is not a
007 * time-zone-aware instant and has no seconds or daylight-saving rules.
008 * </p>
009 * <p>
010 * Each component is stored as a plain integer and validated against the
011 * following ranges:
012 * </p>
013 * <ul>
014 * <li><b>year</b>: 1–9999</li>
015 * <li><b>month</b>: 1–12</li>
016 * <li><b>day</b>: 1 to the maximum days in the given month (respects leap years
017 * for February; see {@link #maxDaysInMonth(int year, int month)})</li>
018 * <li><b>hour</b>: 0–23</li>
019 * <li><b>minute</b>: 0–59</li>
020 * </ul>
021 * <p>
022 * The string form produced by {@link #toString()} is
023 * <code>YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM</code>, e.g. <code>2026/09/15 14:30</code>.
024 * </p>
025 * <p>
026 * There are also static methods for dealing with Time instances.
027 * </p>
028 */
029public class Time implements Comparable<Time> {
030    /*
031     * Static Constants
032     */
033
034    private static final int MIN_YEAR = 1;
035    private static final int MIN_MONTH = 1;
036    private static final int MIN_DAY = 1;
037    private static final int MIN_HOUR = 0;
038    private static final int MIN_MINUTE = 0;
039
040    private static final int MAX_YEAR = 9999;
041    private static final int MAX_MONTH = 12;
042    // There is no MAX_DAY because the highest possible
043    // day is variable, depending on the month.
044    private static final int MAX_HOUR = 23;
045    private static final int MAX_MINUTE = 59;
046
047
048
049    /*
050     * Instance Variables
051     */
052
053    private int year;   // Required
054    private int month;  // Required
055    private int day;    // Required
056    private int hour;   // Required
057    private int minute; // Required
058
059
060
061    /*
062     * Static Methods
063     */
064    
065    /**
066     * Determines whether the specified year is a leap year.
067     * Code adapted from <a href=
068     * "https://www.programiz.com/cpp-programming/examples/leap-year">Programiz</a>.
069     * 
070     * @param year The year to check.
071     * @return <code>true</code> if the year is a leap year, <code>false</code>
072     *         otherwise.
073     */
074    public static boolean isLeapYear(int year) {
075        if (year % 400 == 0)
076            return true;
077        else if (year % 100 == 0)
078            return false;
079        else if (year % 4 == 0)
080            return true;
081
082        return false;
083    }
084
085    /**
086     * Calculates the maximum number of days in the given month and year.
087     * 
088     * @param year  The year.
089     * @param month The month (1-12).
090     * @return The maximum number of days in that month, or -1 if the month is
091     *         invalid.
092     */
093    public static int maxDaysInMonth(int year, int month) {
094        if (month < MIN_MONTH || month > MAX_MONTH)
095            return -1;
096
097        if (month == 2)
098            return isLeapYear(year) ? 29 : 28;
099
100        return switch (month) {
101            case 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12 -> 31;
102            default -> 30;
103        };
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * Returns an informative error message if any time component is invalid, or
108     * <code>null</code> if valid.
109     * 
110     * @param year   The year.
111     * @param month  The month.
112     * @param day    The day.
113     * @param hour   The hour.
114     * @param minute The minute.
115     * @return Description of the error, or <code>null</code> if all values are
116     *         valid.
117     */
118    public static String getValidationError(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute) {
119        if (year < MIN_YEAR || year > MAX_YEAR)
120            return "Year (" + year + ") must be a positive integer between " + MIN_YEAR + " and " + MAX_YEAR + ".";
121        if (month < MIN_MONTH || month > MAX_MONTH)
122            return "Month (" + month + ") must be between " + MIN_MONTH + " and " + MAX_MONTH + ".";
123        int maxDays = maxDaysInMonth(year, month);
124        if (day < MIN_DAY || day > maxDays)
125            return "Day (" + day + ") is invalid: month " + month + " has max " + maxDays + " days.";
126        if (hour < MIN_HOUR || hour > MAX_HOUR)
127            return "Hour (" + hour + ") must be between " + MIN_HOUR + " and " + MAX_HOUR + ".";
128        if (minute < MIN_MINUTE || minute > MAX_MINUTE)
129            return "Minute (" + minute + ") must be between " + MIN_MINUTE + " and " + MAX_MINUTE + ".";
130        return null;
131    }
132
133    /**
134     * Validates whether the specified date and time values represent a valid time.
135     * 
136     * @param year   The year (must be positive, starting from 1).
137     * @param month  The month (1-12).
138     * @param day    The day (1 to max days in month).
139     * @param hour   The hour (0-23).
140     * @param minute The minute (0-59).
141     * @return <code>true</code> if all values are valid, <code>false</code>
142     *         otherwise.
143     */
144    public static boolean isValidTime(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute) {
145        return getValidationError(year, month, day, hour, minute) == null;
146    }
147
148
149
150    /*
151     * Constructors
152     */
153
154    /**
155     * Constructs a <code>Time</code> initialized to minimum allowed values
156     * (0001/01/01 00:00).
157     */
158    public Time() {
159        // Assume default values
160        setYear(MIN_YEAR);
161        setMonth(MIN_MONTH);
162        setDay(MIN_DAY);
163        setHour(MIN_HOUR);
164        setMinute(MIN_MINUTE);
165    }
166
167    /**
168     * <p>
169     * Constructs a <code>Time</code> with specified components.
170     * </p>
171     * <p>
172     * Invalid components are ignored by individual setters, leaving the current or
173     * default component unchanged. Use
174     * {@link #isValidTime(int, int, int, int, int)} when all components must be
175     * accepted together.
176     * </p>
177     * 
178     * @param year   The year.
179     * @param month  The month.
180     * @param day    The day.
181     * @param hour   The hour.
182     * @param minute The minute.
183     */
184    public Time(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute) {
185        // Assume default values
186        this();
187
188        setYear(year);
189        setMonth(month);
190        setDay(day);
191        setHour(hour);
192        setMinute(minute);
193    }
194
195    /**
196     * Constructs a <code>Time</code> by parsing a string in YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM
197     * format. Invalid components default to their minimum allowed values.
198     * 
199     * @param formatString String containing at least five numeric components, such
200     *                     as {@code 2026/09/15 14:30}; separators may be slash,
201     *                     colon, comma, or whitespace.
202     */
203    public Time(String formatString) {
204        // Assume default values
205        this();
206
207        if (formatString == null || formatString.trim().isEmpty())
208            return;
209
210        // Split up components by slashes, colons, commas, or whitespace
211        String[] components = formatString.trim().split("[/:,\\s]+");
212
213        if (components.length >= 5) {
214            try {
215                int y = Integer.parseInt(components[0]);
216                int m = Integer.parseInt(components[1]);
217                int d = Integer.parseInt(components[2]);
218                int h = Integer.parseInt(components[3]);
219                int min = Integer.parseInt(components[4]);
220
221                if (isValidTime(y, m, d, h, min)) {
222                    setYear(y);
223                    setMonth(m);
224                    setDay(d);
225                    setHour(h);
226                    setMinute(min);
227                } else {
228                    System.out.println("One or more fields were not properly entered; defaulting to " + toString() + ".");
229                }
230            } catch (Exception e) {
231                System.out.println("One or more fields were not properly entered; defaulting to " + toString() + ".");
232            }
233        }
234    }
235
236
237
238    /*
239     * Mutators
240     */
241
242    /**
243     * Sets the year if within the valid range (1-9999).
244     * 
245     * @param year The new year.
246     */
247    public void setYear(int year) {
248        if (year >= MIN_YEAR && year <= MAX_YEAR)
249            this.year = year;
250    }
251
252    /**
253     * Sets the month if within the valid range (1-12).
254     * 
255     * @param month The new month.
256     */
257    public void setMonth(int month) {
258        if (month >= MIN_MONTH && month <= MAX_MONTH)
259            this.month = month;
260    }
261
262    /**
263     * Sets the day if within the valid range for the current month and year. Set
264     * year and month first when changing to a date with a different month length.
265     * 
266     * @param day The new day.
267     */
268    public void setDay(int day) {
269        int maxDays = maxDaysInMonth(getYear(), getMonth());
270        
271        // If valid, populate the field.
272        if (day >= MIN_DAY && day <= maxDays)
273            this.day = day;
274    }
275
276    /**
277     * Sets the hour if within the valid range (0-23).
278     * 
279     * @param hour The new hour.
280     */
281    public void setHour(int hour) {
282        if (hour >= MIN_HOUR && hour <= MAX_HOUR)
283            this.hour = hour;
284    }
285
286    /**
287     * Sets the minute if within the valid range (0-59).
288     * 
289     * @param minute The new minute.
290     */
291    public void setMinute(int minute) {
292        if (minute >= MIN_MINUTE && minute <= MAX_MINUTE)
293            this.minute = minute;
294    }
295
296
297
298    /*
299     * Accessors
300     */
301
302    /**
303     * Gets the year.
304     * 
305     * @return The year.
306     */
307    public int getYear() {
308        return this.year;
309    }
310
311    /**
312     * Gets the month.
313     * 
314     * @return The month (1-12).
315     */
316    public int getMonth() {
317        return this.month;
318    }
319
320    /**
321     * Gets the day.
322     * 
323     * @return The day of the month.
324     */
325    public int getDay() {
326        return this.day;
327    }
328
329    /**
330     * Gets the hour.
331     * 
332     * @return The hour (0-23).
333     */
334    public int getHour() {
335        return this.hour;
336    }
337
338    /**
339     * Gets the minute.
340     * 
341     * @return The minute (0-59).
342     */
343    public int getMinute() {
344        return this.minute;
345    }
346
347
348
349    /*
350     * Object Overrides
351     */
352
353    /**
354     * <p>
355     * Returns a string representation of this time in <code>YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM</code>
356     * format.
357     * </p>
358     * <p>
359     * Month, day, hour, and minute are zero-padded to two digits; year is
360     * zero-padded to four. For example, September 5, 2026 at 8:03 AM is formatted
361     * as <code>2026/09/05 08:03</code>.
362     * </p>
363     * 
364     * @return Formatted time string.
365     */
366    @Override
367    public String toString() {
368        return String.format("%04d/%02d/%02d %02d:%02d",
369            getYear(), getMonth(), getDay(),
370            getHour(), getMinute());
371    }
372
373    /**
374     * <p>
375     * Compares this time with another time chronologically.
376     * </p>
377     * <p>
378     * Fields are compared in order: year, then month, then day, then hour, then
379     * minute. The first field that differs determines the result.
380     * </p>
381     * 
382     * @param other The other time to compare with.
383     * @return A negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this time
384     *         precedes, equals, or follows {@code other}.
385     * @throws NullPointerException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
386     */
387    @Override
388    public int compareTo(Time other)
389    throws NullPointerException {
390        if (other == null)
391            throw new NullPointerException("Cannot compare Time to null");
392
393        if (getYear() != other.getYear())
394            return getYear() - other.getYear();
395        
396        if (getMonth() != other.getMonth())
397            return getMonth() - other.getMonth();
398        
399        if (getDay() != other.getDay())
400            return getDay() - other.getDay();
401        
402        if (getHour() != other.getHour())
403            return getHour() - other.getHour();
404
405        return getMinute() - other.getMinute();
406    }
407
408    /**
409     * Determines whether this time is equal to another <code>Time</code>.
410     * 
411     * @param other The other time to compare with.
412     * @return <code>true</code> if both times represent the same moment,
413     *         <code>false</code> otherwise.
414     */
415    public boolean equals(Time other) {
416        if (other == null)
417            return false;
418        return compareTo(other) == 0;
419    }
420
421    /**
422     * Determines whether this time is equal to another object.
423     * 
424     * @param other The object to compare with.
425     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
426     *         otherwise.
427     */
428    @Override
429    public boolean equals(Object other) {
430        if (this == other)
431            return true;
432        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
433            return false;
434        return equals((Time) other);
435    }
436}
